ast.scope: Child source-bound partial syntax; no composed semantic AST.

obernants.assumptions: Source-derived relations; caller enforces valid buffers and resources. f64 NaNs, infinities, casts and zero behavior follow source branches, not mathematical ideal arithmetic. Seven tests observe specific contracts, not all source branches.
obernants.domain: CPU synthetic bounded strings and well-formed matrices with finite modest indices/dimensions/range spans; no GPU, datasets, external API or live filesystem effects.
obernants.observation_scope: lexer space_before distinguishes [1 -2] from [1 - 2]; Caret and DotCaret are both left-folded by the parser, retaining distinct Pow and EPow tags. Interp resolves End to dimensions and dispatches index/ops/core. value column-major layout must survive index gather and core reshape; transpose permutes it. ops short-circuit logic belongs to interp/vm; core callbacks, files, RNG and timer effects cross group and remain unexecuted here.
obernants.operator: Accepted bounded composition excludes erased matrix whitespace, right-associated unparenthesized powers, row-major reinterpretation, broadcast of incompatible non-singleton dimensions and successful shape-changing reshape with unequal numel. It does not exclude public malformed values, nonfinite arithmetic or core side effects.

obernants.operator: For observation y, compatible antecedents are text/AST/state triples whose parse/evaluation gives y. Comments and spellings, overwritten/deleted cells, broadcast operand factorizations and reshape dimension syntax cause ambiguity. Transpose is uniquely invertible only on valid recorded Mat; reshape requires original shape; indexing fixes selected cells only.
